summary:
This plan outlines the steps to:
1. Fix the total discrepancy (R$ 0,99 fee inclusion in server-side calculations).
2. Update WhatsApp redirection to avoid popups and provide an explicit link.
3. Update UI across all pages (Checkout, Tracking, Comanda, Admin) to reflect the new commercial model (0,00 implantação/mensalidade, 0,99 platform service fee).
4. Refactor the financial settlement/repasse service to reflect the new daily-based default and frequency-based cycles.
